name: Clean APIs
description: 33 models with a 0.5M-token monthly free allowance and no card.
overview: Clean APIs exposes 33 models — Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Luna, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro, Qwen3.8 27B, Seed 2.1 Turbo and more — on one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at cleanapis.com/v1. The free plan is 500,000 tokens a month with no card and reaches every model in the catalogue, so the allowance can be spent on a frontier model rather than only on a small one. Paid plans start at $3.50 for 50M tokens, with balance-based overage at list rates.
free_access: No card; all 33 models on the free plan
OpenAI-compatible with streaming, tools and vision
Overage bills at list rates, HTTP 402 when empty
notes: Radox AI and Oxion AI run the same catalogue on their own domains with their own 0.5M/month free allowance and their own signup; codecraftapi.com runs it with no free tier.
